description: Concrete residential apartment buildings in the Greater Golden Horseshoe is a dataset listed in Ontario open data catalogue, an open data portal, published or maintained by Municipal Affairs and Housing. This Geographic Information System (GIS) dataset was prepared for the ministry by the Centre for Urban Growth and Renewal to support the Centre's report "Tower Neighbourhood Renewal in the Greater Golden Horseshoe". Coverage: Ontario. The portal files it under the publisher Municipal Affairs and Housing. Its tags are Gouvernement, Government, Housing Communities and Social Support, Logement collectivités et soutien social. The portal shows 2021-01-14 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ontario-portal.
